title: b12672: metal : add NVFP4 support (#32825)
description: metal : add NVFP4 support Follow the MXFP4 path: add the UE4M3 scale decode, the NVFP4 dequantizers, a dedicated mat-vec kernel with its MUL_MAT_ID, small-batch and MMA variants, the mul_mm / mul_mm_id and tensor-op variants, and the get_rows and cpy kernels. title: b12671
description: metal : batch concat rows and copy them in vector chunks ( #32824 ) metal : batch concat rows and copy them in vector chunks The concat kernel copied one element per thread, so wide rows with many rows ran at a fraction of the memory bandwidth. Batch several rows per threadgroup and copy the contiguous dim-0 elements in 4-element chunks when the row is contiguous.
